Product Details: Power your home with a high-performance solar panel system designed for maximum efficiency and long-term savings. The Bluth Solar On-Grid System uses advanced 550W MonoPERC bifacial solar panels to deliver superior energy output by capturing sunlight from both the front and rear sides. This system is available in multiple capacity configurations to suit different energy needs. A 5kW solar panel system consists of 9 panels (4950W), while higher capacities such as 6kW (11 panels), 8kW (15 panels), and 10kW (18 panels) provide scalable solutions for larger homes and higher electricity consumption. Engineered as a complete on-grid solar panel kit, the system includes a high-efficiency inverter that seamlessly integrates with the utility grid, allowing you to export excess power and significantly reduce electricity bills. Built with DCR-compliant solar panels, it also supports eligibility for government subsidies, making it a cost-effective investment. Ideal for residential and small commercial applications, this solar panel system ensures reliable performance, optimized energy generation, and a sustainable transition to clean energy—backed by Bluth Solar’s expertise in delivering high-quality solar solutions.
